final: WITH rating_counts AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) AS copies FROM inventory AS i JOIN film AS f ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), rating_average AS (SELECT AVG(copies) AS avg_copies FROM rating_counts) SELECT SUM(rc.copies) AS total_copies, AVG(rc.copies - ra.avg_copies) AS avg_excess FROM rating_counts AS rc CROSS JOIN rating_average AS ra WHERE rc.copies > ra.avg_copies
